author: ShutUpThatEpic
body: Hello. A while back on January 31th, 2014, I was banned for advertising. Whether it was a true or false ban I cannot remember, but what I do know is that it was a long time ago. I have learned from my mistakes and if you give me the chance to be unbanned I will never do anything disallowed again. Note: My brother who lives in the same house (same IP) as me has the accounts "EpicHacks" and "Sweat" which he occasionally lets me go on. I know that those accounts were banned for 2 weeks for chat offences, but they are not currently banned so I feel that I shouldn't still be banned on my account.
